column1: # Follow-up probes for the Book of Verse cases OpenVerse accepts where the tests refuse (#724): the Book's case and expectation (for a bp_vm_only case the Blueprint VM's, its Verse VM twin in note), what OpenVerse prints in each probe's header and in note (Lean and C agreeing, at 0471c1d4); Epic's outcome and lines in epic_outcome and epic_lines: UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086, each probe compiled alone with BuildAll on 2026-11-19 (~13:10Z; L the diagnostic's 0-based line of the body as compiled, startLine - 10, before Epic's result was added to its header), the admitted ones run on the Verse VM (newVerseVm=true, 14:41Z; long-ident-class-1024-control alone, in single mode, 14:44Z). Epic refused every probe of an accepted refusal and admitted every control, which printed what OpenVerse prints. The question each asks: does Epic's shipped compiler refuse it?
